Austin Living Massage

5.0 (7 Reviews)
Austin, TX

4 mi
Massage
...

At Austin Living Massage we specialize in the relief of low back, hip and knee pain. We use a combination of Swedish, deep tissue, trigger point and clinical massage therapies to customize a massage for you. This combination is made even more effective with the application Ashiatsu Barefoot Massage and Sarga Bodywork. Using the feet serves threefold 1) It allows the therapist to hold consistent deep pressure sometimes necessary to release knots. 2) The broad aspect of the foot makes the amount of pressure (sometimes up to the the therapists' full bodyweight) more comfortable. 3) The toes and the heel help focus lots of pressure over a small area. Best of both worlds!

Effective Methods

Massage

Providing health and wellness services. Table or chair massage for one private session or events and parties at most locations. Carrie specializes in sports massage and Lymphatic Drainage. Sports massage views the body from an active standpoint, this can incorporate anything from light recovery effleurage massage techniques to deep trigger point work. Sports massage will aim to align with the clients personal or professional wellness goals. Carrie studied the Klose technique of Manual Lymphatic Drainage Massage. This approach works with the Lymphatic system to boost the Lymphatic Drainage or processing. This style of massage does not include true fluid draining. Your Lymphatic fluid will naturally process and "drain" out through the help of kidneys and liver removing anything useless with other body waste. Carrie has 16 years of experience working with the body and is an avid cyclist who may spend her rainy days in the gym lifting weights.
